It never invokes the named shell collector or the intake log-fetch path, although it enforces its own GET budget. All three reviewers rated this NIT, and anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 lists it for completeness only, as a previously accepted deviation.

The noise/environmental override at lines 691-699 checks only `files_blocked or group.get("stalled")`, so a pipeline-origin noise or environmental group routes to `done`, and the `unsure` route bypasses all host criteria. tests/test_alert_triage.py:255-260 encodes this deviation, and the code comment documents it. All three reviewers rated this MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 considers it an accepted deviation and did not raise it.

  expected_change_site: prompts/_templates/mode-alert-triage.txt
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
